title: No Thoroughfare
author: Charles Dickens · Wilkie Collins
description: "No Thoroughfare" by Charles Dickens and Wilkie Collins is a stage play and novel both released in December 1867.
longDescription: Two boys from a foundling hospital are mistakenly given the same name, leading to devastating consequences in adulthood. After one's death, executors must find the rightful heir, embarking on a dangerous journey from London wine cellars across the winter Alps to the Mediterranean.

authorInfo.bio: Charles Dickens · Wilkie Collins (1812–1870) is the author of No Thoroughfare. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
